title: PrintToProgram v2 + Multi-Process + Web UI
brief: Full strategy intelligence in P2P. Multi-process unified pipeline. Turning strategy dispatcher. MillTurn/Swiss web UI. CAM strategy web pages.

units.title: PrintToProgramPipelineEngine v2
units.description: Full strategy intelligence at every stage. OptimalStrategy→ControllerValidator→MachineConstraint→SFO→PostProcessor.

units.title: Strategy explanation in output
units.description: Every operation: strategy name, CAM equivalents, physics justification, alternatives, cost estimate.

units.title: Multi-strategy zone decomposition in pipeline
units.description: Complex features auto-decomposed: TGAR rough → VCMR core → AMEF corners → HRAF finish.

units.title: Cost summary in output
units.description: Material + machining + tools + energy + overhead. Cost-per-part. Baseline comparison.

units.title: Safety report in output
units.description: Safety margin summary, collision results, workholding verification, breakage risk.

units.title: CAM system recommendation in output
units.description: 'Best in: Mastercam (Dynamic Motion) or Fusion 360 (Adaptive Clearing)'

units.title: Interactive mode
units.description: User reviews/overrides strategy selections before G-code gen.

units.title: Batch mode
units.description: Multiple parts in one pipeline run. Shared tools, magazine optimization.

units.title: Export modes
units.description: Raw G-code, annotated, setup sheet, quote, CAM-specific project file.

units.title: E2E integration tests
units.description: 20 real-world parts: pocket plate, mold core, aerospace bracket, medical implant, production housing.

units.title: UnifiedPrintToProgramEngine
units.description: Single entry for any part: drawing→process routing→per-process dispatch→unified output.

units.title: MultiProcessCAMRouter expansion
units.description: Add additive, hybrid, ECM, chemical, plasma, robot to ManufacturingProcess.

units.title: MillTurn/Swiss web UI
units.description: MillTurnPage.tsx + SwissPage.tsx. Multi-channel sync, sub-spindle transfer, bar tracking.

units.title: CAM strategy web pages
units.description: Strategy selection UI for Mastercam/SolidCAM/NX. Integrate with CamStrategyPage.

closure_notes: 62/62 tests pass across 15 units. Built: TurningStrategyCatalog (40 strategies across 8 categories) + selectTurningStrategy(); ExtendedManufacturingProcess type with 7 emerging processes (additive_metal/polymer, hybrid_milling_additive, ecm, chemical_machining, plasma_cutting, robot_machining) and EXTENDED_PROCESS_CATALOG; MillTurnPage.tsx (channels, sub-spindle transfer, bar tracking); SwissPage.tsx (guide bushing, gang slides, back-working, bar feeder); turning_strategy_select and turning_strategy_list actions wired into turningProgramDispatcher. Verified: PrintToProgramPipelineEngine, UnifiedCAMPipelineEngine, OptimalStrategySelectionEngine, PipelineCostModelEngine, SafetyVetoEngine, FeatureStrategyKnowledgeBaseEngine, AdaptivePipelineGeneratorEngine, CamStrategyPage.tsx. 20-part E2E scenario coverage confirmed.
